title: Authentication Slice Source Import Manifest
description: Controlled self-defined authentication-slice source import sub-manifest for authentication, identity-access, provider-mode, UI, proof, event, audit, observability, and data rows selected by the USF-65 capability/source coverage matrix. Every row carries an inline USF-native source reference. Rows reconcile to the baseline source import manifest and refine broad target concepts to authored semantic instances or specific governed slice concepts. This is USF's own source-path registry and imports no runtime/application code.
aiGuidance: Use this sub-manifest for authentication-slice source-use decisions in USF-64. Do not copy code or treat disposition as implementation acceptance.
